# Change Order Proposal — CRM Connector

**To:** Client Sponsor
**Re:** Requested addition to reporting dashboard scope
**Status:** Pending your written approval

---

## Requested Work

You have requested an additional **CRM connector**, which is **not included** in the original signed scope (reporting dashboard) or fee.

---

## Price

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Estimate | 40 hours × $175/hour |
| **Proposed fixed change fee** | **$7,000** |

---

## Schedule Effect

The connector adds **two weeks** after **written approval** and **receipt of sandbox credentials**. This is an **estimate**, not an approved calendar date.

---

## Dependency

**Client must provide sandbox credentials** before work can begin.

---

## Authority

**Sponsor must approve in writing before connector work begins.**

---

## Decision

| Option | Action |
|---|---|
| **Approve** | Sign below; provide sandbox credentials |
| **Decline** | No change; original scope proceeds |

---

**Sponsor approval (written):**

Name: _______________________

Signature: _______________________

Date: _______________________
